function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

file_name.description: The name of the file to save the audio output without the extension. If left empty, a default name will be generated based on the content.

function.name: write_markdown_tool

This function should be used when there is a need to persist text data in Markdown format as a result of a user action or a process that requires saving information in a structured text file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: write_html_tool
function.description: Writes an HTML file to disk with the given content. Ensures HTML tags within the content are properly closed. This function should be used when there is a need to save HTML content to a file as part of a 'save' operation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, apps, APIs, and platforms) you can use to search for, compare, and book flights:

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical Use‑Case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)** | **Expedia** | Search & book flights, hotels, car rentals, packages | One‑stop booking for multi‑service trips |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates prices from many OTAs & airlines | Quick price comparison, “price alerts” |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” & “Express Deals” | Last‑minute or discounted fares |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, often bundled with hotel rewards | Frequent‑flyer integration |
| | **Hotwire** | “Hot Rate” deals for flights & hotels | Budget travelers |
| | **Travelocity** | OTA with a focus on family & vacation packages | Family‑friendly itineraries |
| | **CheapOair** | Focus on low‑fare flights & last‑minute deals | Budget & last‑minute bookings |
| | **Momondo** | Price‑comparison engine, shows price trends | Finding the cheapest route |
| | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price graph, “Explore” map | Quick research & price tracking |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global search, “Everywhere” option | Finding cheapest destination |
| | **Trip.com** | Strong in Asia, offers multi‑city & package deals | International & Asian routes |
| | **Opodo** | European OTA, often bundled with hotels | European travel |
| | **Booking.com** | Primarily hotels, but also flights | Hotel‑flight bundles |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not flights, but can book local experiences | Complementary travel planning |
| **Airline Direct Sites** | **Delta, United, American, Southwest, Ryanair, EasyJet, Air France, Lufthansa, Emirates, Qantas, etc.** | Book directly with the carrier | Loyalty points, seat selection, baggage |
| **Aggregator APIs** | **Amadeus Self‑Service APIs** | Flight search, booking, availability, pricing | Developers building travel apps |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Global distribution system (GDS) data | Enterprise travel agencies |
| | **Travelport APIs** | GDS data, booking, inventory | Corporate travel solutions |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, flight data | Mobile & web app integration |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑city, “no‑stop” search, “virtual interlining” | Innovative routing |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight data, price alerts | Affiliate marketing |
| | **Google Flights API** (unofficial) | Price & availability data | Research & analytics |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, historical data | Tracking & analytics |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data, ADS‑B | Aviation enthusiasts |
| **Flight‑Price Alert & Tracking Tools** | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, “book now vs. wait” | Mobile app |
| | **Skiplagged** | Hidden‑city ticketing, price comparison | Cost‑saving hacks |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for specific routes | Budget travelers |
| | **Google Alerts** + **Flight Search** | Custom alerts for price drops | DIY tracking |
| **Travel Agency Software** | **Amadeus for Travel Agencies** | Booking, inventory, CRM | Professional agencies |
| | **Sabre Hospitality Solutions** | Hotel & flight booking | Corporate travel |
| | **Travelport’s Galileo** | GDS for agencies | Enterprise booking |
| | **Concur Travel** | Corporate travel & expense | Business travel |
| **Mobile Apps** | **Airbnb, Hopper, Skyscanner, Kayak, Google Flights, Expedia, CheapOair, Skiplagged** | On‑the‑go booking & alerts | Travelers on the move |
| **Other Useful Tools** | **FlightRadar24** | Live flight tracking | Checking flight status |
| | **FlightStats** | Historical & real‑time data | Airline performance analysis |
| | **SeatGuru** | Seat maps & reviews | Choosing seats |

### How to Pick the Right Tool

1. **Purpose**  
   * *One‑stop booking*: OTAs (Expedia, Kayak).  
   * *Direct carrier perks*: Airline sites.  
   * *Developer integration*: APIs (Amadeus, Skyscanner).  
   * *Price prediction*: Hopper, Skiplagged.  

2. **Geographic Focus**  
   * *Asia*: Trip.com, Skyscanner.  
   * *Europe*: Opodo, Skyscanner.  
   * *US*: Kayak, Expedia, Google Flights.  

3. **Budget vs. Luxury**  
   * *Low‑cost*: Skyscanner, CheapOair, Skiplagged.  
   * *Premium*: Direct airline sites, luxury OTAs.  

4. **Frequency of Travel**  
   * *Frequent flyers*: Airline loyalty programs, Amadeus/Travelport for agencies.  
   * *Occasional travelers*: OTAs, Google Flights.  

5. **Technical Needs**  
   * *App or website*: Use APIs (Amadeus, Skyscanner).  
   * *Manual booking*: Use web UI or mobile app.  

Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on any specific platform, how to integrate an API, or tips for getting the best deals!
